description: This Dart file defines the CartProvider class, which manages a shopping cart's items, updates, and analytics logging within a Flutter app.

classes.name: CartProvider
classes.description: A ChangeNotifier class that manages cart items, calculates subtotal, and logs cart-related events.

methods.name: CartProvider
methods.description: Constructor that initializes CartProvider with an AnalyticsService.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds an item selection to the cart and logs the add event.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing item at a specified index.

methods.name: removeAt
methods.description: Removes an item at a specified index and logs the removal event.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears all items from the cart.
